name: Kayahara Fuyumi
source:
[url=/c6398]Yukiko's[/url] mother. She raised Yukiko by herself while also working at a nursery. 

She’s very candid, but is also exceptionally good at looking after others. She’s a regular customer at the coffee shop "Moon World" and is also an acquaintance of [url=/c4082]Kyouko[/url]. 

"I want some coffee too, Hazuki-chan."

[From [url=http://www.mangagamer.com/detail.php?goods_type=1&product_code=139]MangaGamer[/url]]

[spoiler]Her real name is Ayako. Marked by a past incident, she was, in many ways, reborn as someone else. She also remains bound to Tomoyuki Masaki by ties not easily severed.[/spoiler]
